Trenutni urnik ima vnos z `from: "thu"` in `to: "fri"`, ki velja za četrtek in petek (07:00–14:00). Petek se mora zato ločiti od četrtka. Četrtek ostane do 14:00, petek pa je do 15:00. Odprtja ob petkih nisem spreminjal, ostane 07:00.

Vnos na indeksu 3 zamenjam z dvema vnosoma: četrtek 07:00–14:00 in petek 07:00–15:00.

```json
{"reply":"Ob petkih je ordinacijski čas zdaj do 15.00, četrtek ostaja do 14.00.","patches":[{"op":"replace","path":"/business/hours/entries/3","value":{"from":"thu","to":"thu","open":"07:00","close":"14:00"}},{"op":"add","path":"/business/hours/entries/4","value":{"from":"fri","to":"fri","open":"07:00","close":"15:00"}}]}
```
